localChanges: A loaded game opens on your first city, or your first unit if you have no cities, instead of the corner of the map, which was often unexplored and black (closes #826).
Zoomed all the way out, city banners show each city's name beside its size again (closes #822).
In the Trade report, a city with no upkeep shows 0 rather than -0 (closes #816).
On a phone, the details beside the build list are no longer pressed against the window's edge (closes #827).
